name: code-impact-review
description: AI code impact analysis skill and MCP server using git diff, LuaLS MCP for Lua, CodeGraph fallback, AI review, and report artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze code changes, callers, risk, tests, and review reports.
interface.longDescription: Runs git diff based impact analysis, resolves Lua caller/reference impact through LuaLS MCP, uses CodeGraph for fallback and other languages, optionally asks an OpenAI-compatible model for risk and review synthesis, and emits Markdown, HTML, JSON, and prompt artifacts for AI-assisted code review.
defaultPrompt: Analyze impact for this branch against origin/master.
Review changed Lua and C++ functions with caller risk.
Generate impact report, tests, and code review findings.
